title: Sea around Mauritius, animated, last 60 days
summary: 60 daily maps of sea surface temperature around Mauritius up to 14 November 2026, from the Meteomatics weather API, played as a smooth animation.
description: Sea surface temperature (t_sea_sfc, model mix, noon UTC) from the Meteomatics Weather API for a box about 3.5 degrees across, centred on Mauritius, drawn smoothly in blue, green, yellow and orange. The island is grey, which the app reads as no data, with a dark coastline. The values are model values on a 0.02 degree grid, so they are about, not exact.

source.name: Meteomatics Weather API, t_sea_sfc:C (model mix)
source.credit: Sea surface temperature from the Meteomatics Weather API, drawn by the Earth Jukebox team.
source.license: Used under the team's Meteomatics subscription. Check Meteomatics' terms before sharing the frames or the video.

regions.name: Mauritius and its seas
regions.description: The sea and island in a box about 3.5 degrees across, centred on Mauritius.

story.title: The first weeks
story.text: From 16 September 2026 to 6 October 2026 the sea around Mauritius is between 23.9 and 24.8 °C in the middle of the map. These are model values from Meteomatics, drawn smoothly; the island is grey and counts as no data.

story.title: The middle weeks
story.text: From 7 October 2026 to 26 October 2026 the sea around Mauritius is between 20.0 and 25.6 °C in the middle of the map. These are model values from Meteomatics, drawn smoothly; the island is grey and counts as no data.

story.title: The latest weeks
story.text: From 27 October 2026 to 14 November 2026 the sea around Mauritius is between 24.8 and 26.5 °C in the middle of the map. These are model values from Meteomatics, drawn smoothly; the island is grey and counts as no data.
